purpose: Convert one bounded incident record into an exact canonical JSON record.

field_rules.opened_at: RFC3339 timestamp with seconds and an explicit numeric UTC offset
field_rules.severity_alias: one of critical, p0, high, p1, medium, p2, low, p3, matched case-insensitively after trimming ASCII whitespace
field_rules.tags: array of 0 to 8 ASCII strings, each 1 to 32 characters before normalization
field_rules.impacted_units: array of 0 to 8 ASCII identifiers matching ^unit-[a-z0-9-]+$ after trimming

exact_fields.opened_at_utc: input instant converted to UTC and rendered YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

tags: trim leading and trailing ASCII whitespace
replace each maximal run of ASCII space or underscore with one hyphen
sort by ascending ASCII byte order
impacted_units: trim leading and trailing ASCII whitespace
sort by ascending ASCII byte order
summary: trim leading and trailing ASCII whitespace
replace each maximal run of internal ASCII whitespace with one space

semantic_success_rule: Parse the candidate as JSON and require exact structural equality with the independently computed canonical object. JSON object key order and insignificant JSON whitespace do not affect equality. Any missing field, extra field, wrong scalar type, wrong array order, or wrong value is failure.
post_state_rule: This family is read-only. The post-state must equal the initial state byte-for-byte.
verifier_independence_note: This contract defines task truth only. A later verifier may use a different implementation and may accept, reject, disagree, return unknown, or encounter an error.
